title: Organic Food Labeling: How To Tell If Packaged Food Is Organic
summary: Short explainer on reading USDA Organic, made-with-organic and ingredient-list organic claims on packaged food.

assertions.quote: it's your guarantee that 95% of those ingredients are organic
the next level down is the made with 70% organic ingredients
any product that has less than 70% organic in it won't have anything on the front packaging

verdicts.note: 7 CFR 205.305 limits products under 70 percent organic to identifying organic ingredients in the ingredient statement.

7 CFR 205.301(d) says products with under 70 percent organic ingredients may represent their organic nature only as 205.305 provides; 205.305 (identifying organic ingredients in the ingredient statement) is not in this excerpt.
